value.rationale: The same-model paper explicitly identifies the nonlinear cycle-stability test as an unfinished problem. An exact sign theorem for the first Lyapunov coefficient distinguishes a universal supercritical region from a nonempty, explicit subcritical region and gives a unique timescale switch. This classifies whether local learning-resource oscillations are attracting or repelling rather than merely confirming a Hopf crossing.
